title: Wadi Al Salam, Al-Ukhaidir & Karbala Shrines
full_text:
we begin the day by visiting Wadi Al-Salam (The Valley of Peace) in Najaf, recognized as the largest cemetery in the world and a site of immense spiritual and historical scale.
Afterward, we will drive towards Karbala.
Our first stop in the area will be the Al-Ukhaidir Fortress, a magnificent Abbasid-era limestone castle.
You will explore its unique architectural innovation, including its grand courtyards, residential quarters, and ancient mosque.
Later in the afternoon, we will head to the heart of the city for a walking tour between the Shrines of Imam Hussain and his brother Abbas.
During the tour, you will receive a detailed historical explanation of the Battle of Karbala and the deep cultural significance of these landmarks.
